canonicalSourceCandidate.name: DOT-NL / NDW
canonicalSourceCandidate.operator: Nationaal Dataportaal Wegverkeer (NDW), on behalf of the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management

rationale: NDW states that DOT-NL exclusively concerns publicly accessible charging points.
CPOs are required to submit their publicly accessible charging infrastructure to the Dutch National Access Point under AFIR.
A charger can remain publicly accessible even when located behind a barrier or in a parking facility if access is generally obtainable, including indirectly by becoming a customer or member.
Therefore private land, parking restrictions or opening hours must not be used by TCC as automatic non-public exclusion signals.
